central_claim: AI poses a serious existential danger to humanity, and this is worth taking seriously and acting on.
stance_note: agree = accepts AI is a serious existential danger worth acting on; disagree = rejects it as incapable, hype or fearmongering; mixed = accepts part, rejects or reframes part (e.g. blames companies, not AI).
coder_instructions: Code what the comment says, not the person. Comments are often written in the video's own simplified register; do not mark unclear just because the grammar is broken. When a comment fits two frames, pick the one it leads with. No like counts were available for this capture; do not infer or estimate them.

values.label: Agree
values.definition: accepts AI is a serious existential danger worth acting on

values.label: Disagree
values.definition: rejects the claim: not capable, hype, fearmongering

values.label: Mixed
values.definition: accepts part, rejects or reframes part

values.label: Na
values.definition: on topic but no readable position

values.label: Unclear
values.definition: genuinely cannot be told either way; used sparingly

values.label: Warning accepted
values.definition: straightforwardly agrees AI is dangerous and this is a real warning

values.label: Capability scepticism
values.definition: AI isn't actually that smart or capable; doubts the premise on technical grounds

values.label: Stunt or hype
values.definition: dismisses the video, incident or field as marketing, fearmongering or hype without a specific capability argument

values.label: Accountability frame
values.definition: the real danger is the people, companies or billionaires controlling AI, not the AI itself

values.label: Not really programmed
values.definition: technical pushback that AI is just software or code, not sentient, only does what it's told

values.label: Imitation meme
values.definition: writes in the video's own simplified caveman register as a joke or homage, no other stated position

values.label: Format criticism
values.definition: criticises the simplified delivery as condescending, dumbed-down or patronising

values.label: Format praise
values.definition: praises the simplified delivery as helpful, clear or well-explained

values.label: Scifi reference
values.definition: leads with a reference to a film, book, game or fictional AI

values.label: Direct action
values.definition: calls for direct or physical action against AI or its infrastructure

values.label: Policy regulation
values.definition: calls for legislative, regulatory or political action

values.label: Resignation fatalism
values.definition: nothing can be done, it's already too late, doomed regardless

values.label: Near term harm
values.definition: centres a present-day harm (water, energy, jobs) rather than the existential claim

values.label: Sentience question
values.definition: asks or argues about whether AI is conscious, sentient or deserves moral consideration

values.label: Messenger credibility
values.definition: comments on Soares, MIRI, the book, or his credibility specifically

values.label: General agreement
values.definition: short agreement or praise with no further elaboration

values.label: Humour only
values.definition: a joke, meme or reaction with no other content and no stance-bearing frame

values.label: Other
values.definition: doesn't fit any of the above; off-topic tangents

values.label: None
values.definition: no reaction to the simplified-English format

values.label: Imitates
values.definition: writes in the same simplified register

values.label: Mock
values.definition: mocks or ridicules the format

values.label: Condescended
values.definition: treats the format as insulting or patronising

values.label: Praise
values.definition: praises the format as effective or helpful
